metadata.name: HSU TwinFlow expanded material-flow graph
metadata.description: Expanded nodes and edges extracted from the TikZ material-flow diagram. Ranges such as CC_1--6 and RC_8--14 are expanded into individual conveyor nodes.
metadata.expansion_rule: A label PREFIX_i--j is represented as individual nodes PREFIX_i, PREFIX_{i+1}, ..., PREFIX_j with internal_sequence edges.
metadata.bidirectional_edges: Bidirectional TikZ arrows are encoded as two directed edges.
